description: This PHP source file defines the 'Store' controller class for the Opencart admin extension module. It handles rendering the store configuration page (index method) and saving configuration settings (save method).

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for managing the store module's settings page in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares and outputs the store configuration page, constructing breadcrumbs and loading required views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the store module settings, performing permission checks and returning JSON response.
